mainEntity.name: How can I decide if a second-story addition or a ground-level expansion is right for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between a second-story addition and a ground-level expansion depends on several factors, including your lot size, existing foundation capabilities, and desired use of the new space. A second-story addition can maximize space on smaller lots and often provides better views, but it requires a robust foundation and staircase integration. A ground-level expansion might be less disruptive initially and offer easier access but requires available land. We can assess your property and discuss these tradeoffs during our initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose based on lot size, foundation capacity, and desired use; second stories save ground space but require structural work, while ground expansions need available land.
